title: Mean, median, and mode
subject: Math
learningGoal: Compute mean, median, and mode of a small data set.
spokenLines: Three measures of center: mean, median, mode.
Data: two, four, four, seven, nine.
Mean is the average — add them up, divide by how many.
Two plus four plus four plus seven plus nine is twenty six.
Divide by five, that's five point two.
Median is the middle number of the sorted list. Here it's four.
Mode is the number that appears most often. That's four as well.
So mean five point two, median four, mode four.
